claim: Within the inherited frozen diagnosis, operation language, execution confirmation and composition bound, requiring every adopted mapping repair to expose exactly the complete observed top-level contract is sufficient for behaviourally compositional reach across every demand-bearing member of a fresh finite structural population: B remains unreachable from S0, becomes reachable after exact-contract A, and becomes unreachable again when A is removed. Every world with no visible A demand must remain negative.

historical_boundary.development_population: the already observed M095 qualification population
historical_boundary.development_result: 6/6 demand-bearing relations recovered and 3/3 zero-demand controls remained negative; this is development evidence only

falsifiers: Any of the eight demand-bearing qualification entries fails to demonstrate the enabling relation under the exact contract.
Any of the four zero-inner-demand entries demonstrates the relation or is excluded.
A ranking-unaided entry requires descent, or a declared descent entry is reported as unaided.
B is reachable from S0, A is not identified by the measured applicability flip, B is not execution-confirmed after A, or B remains reachable without A.
Any adopted A has a top-level output key absent from the observed contract, omits a demanded key, contains a duplicate key, or uses an open mapping literal.
The complete-contract paired legacy liveness control does not run successfully, or the paired arms do not start from the same measured world.
Any recorded entry differs from a clean local replay.
The protocol, population, mechanism, operation set, composition bound, runner or checker moves after freeze.
A population member is dropped, rerolled, overwritten or replaced after its outcome is known.
A model call, network call, remote runner, dirty tree or pre-freeze enabling outcome enters Track A.

mechanism.digest_rule: sha256 of canonical JSON mapping each listed path to its raw sha256
mechanism.additive_change: replace subset mapping acceptance with closed exact top-level mapping acceptance only for the scoped M096 run; restore the inherited M095 shapes afterwards
mechanism.inherited_unchanged: diagnosis, operation enumeration, composition order and bound, execution probe, nested reach operation, world measurement and lineage control flow

qualification_apparatus.digest_rule: sha256 of canonical JSON mapping each listed path to its raw sha256

qualification_population.construction: exhaustive Cartesian product, not a draw

paired_legacy_arm.purpose: measure sensitivity to exact versus subset acceptance in byte-independent copies of every frozen world
paired_legacy_arm.required_liveness: both complete_minimal_contract positive entries must remain demonstrable under the inherited subset mechanism
paired_legacy_arm.partial_contract_outcomes: reported without a required direction because content-addressed survivor ordering can select an exact legacy survivor; M095 attempt 1 remains the preserved negative evidence for subset non-composition

owner_authorization: The project owner instructed the agent on 2026-08-22 to continue locally until M095's exposed cause and the successor stages were validated. This authorizes local freeze and execution, not public push.
verdict_rule: negative if any computed condition fails; incomplete while any condition is uncomputed; positive only when all ten conditions are computed and true
